Maria (infra): Quick check — per the postmortem (inc-845) we split the follow-ups. Can owners confirm ETA/blocks?
- Ajay: DB schema backfill
- Chloe: Canary rollback automation
- Dylan: Observability dash for latency regressions
Please reply with due dates or :handshake: if you're blocked.

Ajay: Ack. I'll take DB backfill. ETA: 2024-07-19. Main blocker: migration lock window, need migration runbook from infra.

Chloe: Taking canary rollback. ETA: 2024-07-17. Blocker: need read/write test fixture from QA. @Zoe any chance to prioritize?

Zoe (PM): Can follow up with QA, will ask for test fixture by EOD today. Chloe, if you need a dev-review slot I can book one Fri.

Dylan: Observability dash — I need samples of the spike traces. @Maria can you paste the trace IDs? Otherwise ETA 2024-07-21.

Maria (infra): trace IDs: trace-09a3f, trace-0b7c2. Also dumped relevant grafana panel: /d/infra/latency-spike. QA test fixture request sent to qa-ops.

Ajay: Migration runbook question — can we avoid full table lock? I propose chunked backfill, will draft steps and post.

Chloe: FYI if QA can't deliver, I can run canary rollback dry-run in staging. Need a 30min window.

SRE Bot: incident-845 postmortem published: https://redwood-internal/postmortems/845

Zoe (PM): Thanks all. Can owners confirm final due dates by EOD today so I can update the tracker? Also confirm who will be primary reviewer for each PR.

Ajay: Final ETA 2024-07-19, reviewer: @Dylan. Will post runbook by tomorrow AM.

Chloe: Final ETA 2024-07-17, reviewer: @Maria. Will request staging slot once QA confirms.

Dylan: Final ETA 2024-07-21, reviewer: @Chloe. I'll upload dash draft to the repo.

Maria (infra): Noted. If any blockers pop up ping #eng-oncall. Thanks.

Zoe (PM): Locking these in. I'll send a short calendar invite for cutover review on 2024-07-18 10:00 PT.

Ajay: Received :thumbsup:
